extracted.name: Vegetable Pancake 蔬菜煎饼
extracted.description: This delicious and colorful pancake is made with shredded cabbage, carrot, and scallions, mixed with a bit of flour and egg. Each pancake is cooked with an egg in the center—soft with a slightly runny yolk. It’s pan-fried until golden and delicious, perfect for breakfast, lunch, or a light dinner. Enjoy!
instruction_lines: In a bowl, combine cabbage, carrot, scallions, flour, 1 egg
Add salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium low heat.Add a scoop of the veggie mix to the pan, form a nest.
Crack an egg into the center.
Cook 3–4 minutes until golden, then flip and cook 2–3 more minutes to set the egg white.Enjoy!
